description: Official OpenClaw runtime, Control UI, and WebChat integration.

upstream.name: openclaw/openclaw
upstream.notes: Official Windows docs recommend WSL2 for the full experience; native Windows remains a caveated path.

commands.setup: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! node -e "const [major, minor] = process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); process.exit(major > 22 || (major === 22 && minor >= 14) ? 0 : 1)"; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs; fi && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.2 --activate && if [ ! -f dist/entry.js ] || [ ! -d node_modules ]; then pnpm install && pnpm build; fi && mkdir -p ../../data/openclaw ../../data/logs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const p=process.env.OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH || path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../../data/openclaw/openclaw.json'); let c={}; try { c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); } catch {} c.gateway={ mode:'local', bind:'loopback', ...(c.gateway||{}) }; c.logging={ ...(c.logging||{}), file:path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../../data/logs/openclaw-runtime.log') }; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(c,null,2));"

integration.summary: Verified real OpenClaw source payload in managed ClawHermes-Ubuntu WSL2 distro with Node 24, pnpm 10.33.2, local gateway config, project-local state/log paths, and http://127.0.0.1:18789/healthz returning 200.
